pairs.subject: client-fetch-cache
pairs.evidence: src/features/overview/sub_health/libs/useStatusPageData.ts:75 The SLA, healing and daily series the status page fetched live only in component state, so every navigation back to Health remounts empty: the first frames compute entries with no SLA data and grade every persona 'unknown' until a fresh round trip lands, a cold paint for data the client held seconds earlier.

techniques.evidence: src/features/overview/sub_health/libs/useStatusPageData.ts:75 Fetched data is held in useState with no module-scoped last-result cache, so unmount throws it away. HealingEffectivenessPanel.tsx:43 (`useState<HealingEffectivenessReport | null>(null)`) does the same.

src/features/overview/sub_health/libs/useStatusPageData.ts:183 Every return to the tab refetches no matter how old the data is. That is an environmental focus trigger, and no fresh window or stale ceiling is declared (only a 60s poll). One part does conform: a rejected SLA read only calls setSlaError at line 115 and keeps the stale rows on screen beside the error.

src/features/overview/sub_events/libs/useEventLog.ts:156 The event log paints a small first page, then defers the 50-row backfill to idle with a timeout fallback. An `active` flag guards it so the backfill dies with the view.

src/features/overview/sub_events/HighlightedJson.tsx:49 The parse and colorize step is memoized on the raw string, which is its content identity. A parse failure falls back to the raw text and is not memoized as a transient error.

pairs.subject: client-fetch-cache
pairs.evidence: src/features/overview/sub_memories/components/MemoryConflictReview.tsx:182 Resolving a conflict calls fetchMemories() with no filters, and the result goes into the single, unkeyed store slot `memories` that the Memories tab paints under its active search, persona, tier and sort filters. Dense's fetch effect does not re-run on a tab switch, so the list then shows an unfiltered first page labelled with filters that did not produce it.

techniques.evidence: src/features/overview/sub_memories/components/MemoryConflictReview.tsx:182 The store entry is not keyed by query arguments, so one slot answers several different questions. The same happens at MemoriesPageDense.tsx:615 after delete-all, and at MemoriesPageGraph.tsx:72, which fetches its own unfiltered query into the slot Dense paints as 'pre-warmed'.

src/features/overview/sub_memories/components/MemoryConflictReview.tsx:75 The pairwise conflict derivation is pure and memoized on the array reference, and detectConflicts stays the single place it is computed.

src/features/overview/sub_memories/components/MemoryDetailModal.tsx:22 The detail modal renders the full list row it is handed and makes no separate detail read, so there is no lag for a borrowed summary to cover.
